title: HB1737 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 16; Title 36; Title 37; Title 38; Title 39; Title 40; Title 49 and Title 65, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2026-01-21; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 3325861)
provenance.note: Draft dated 2026-01-21 (as filed; text via LegiScan). Sections 1 and 3 repeal old text in 39-17-1307 and 39-17-1311 and substitute new 39-17-1307; per the summary, deleting 39-17-1311 removes the public park/recreation-area weapons offence. Many sections only change cross-references or delete 'carrying or'. Amendments, if any, are not in the text read.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307): (a) (1) A person commits an offense who possesses a firearm and: (A) Has been convicted of a felony crime of violence or an attempt to commit a felony crime of violence; (B) Has been convicted of a felony drug offense; (C) Has been convicted of a felony offense other than an offense under subdivision (a)(1)(A) or (a)(1)(B);
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307): (e) A person does not possess a firearm if the firearm is in a safe or similar container that is securely locked and to which the person does not have the combination, key, or other means of normal access.
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1311): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1311, is amended by deleting the section.
SECTION 36 (TCA 37-1-190): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 37-1-190, is amended by deleting the section.
SECTION 28 (TCA 39-17-1316): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1316, is amended by deleting subdivisions (a)(1)(A)(i) and (a)(1)(A)(v).
SECTION 33 (TCA 39-17-1359(f)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1359(f), is amended by deleting the last sentence.
